name: LangSmith
summary: Traces, datasets, evaluations and prompt versioning, most seamless if you already build with LangChain.
description:
LangSmith answers the question every LLM feature eventually raises: what exactly happened in that request. Nested traces show each step, tool call and retry with token counts and cost, and the dataset-plus-evaluator loop is a workable path from anecdote to regression test. Annotation queues make human review part of the pipeline instead of a spreadsheet.

It is a hosted product, so prompt contents and user data live with the vendor — a decision some teams cannot make. Non-LangChain instrumentation works but is less ergonomic, and pricing tied to traces and seat roles needs modelling before you wire it into every service.
